tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get the icon file, Get images from Figma data based on the imageRef of image nodes

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file containing the node

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to fetch

fileName.description: The name of the file to fetch

localPath.description: The absolute path to the directory where images are stored in the project

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: When the nodeId cannot be obtained, obtain the layout information about the entire Figma file

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to fetch

depth.description: How many levels deep to traverse the node tree, only use if explicitly requested by the user

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get layout information about a specific node in a Figma file

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file containing the node, often found in a provided URL like figma.com/(file|design)/<fileKey>/...

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to fetch, often found as URL parameter node-id=<nodeId>

depth.description: How many levels deep to traverse the node tree
